posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: I don't suppose we could consider not making her flip just yet?  It might be nice if we could take several more turns to set up before we make her get hyper-violent.  IIRC, her flipside deals 3 damage to every hero and plays three villain cards each turn....that could turn into a slaughter fast.  Flipping her now means not losing 5 ongoings, but wouldn't it be better to get like ten ongoings into play while not taking damage, giving us time to heal and hoard cards and such?

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked: There is merit there, as of right now we have cards to get 4 hp per round, with adept and Tempest making 2 downpours, let Adept get built up and spam some ongoings to protect the ones we really want.  I'm cool either way, but Envisioner's plan would work.

posts.name: grysqrl
posts.cooked:
I'm in favor of flipping her now. Most of Tempest's setup is Ongoing, so there's not much point in playing a bunch of things just to get them destroyed. Wraith has a decent setup to move forward with. Expat and Ra have some damage potential and more cards to play. She's still going to be dealing us damage on this side. What exactly are you looking to get into play before we flip her? Will one turn suffice?

I can play and use Cleansing Downpour once the risk of massive ongoing destruction has passed, so that should negate a chunk of her damage.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
grysqrl:

What exactly are you looking to get into play before we flip her?

I'm the Argent Adept, so "everything" is a valid answer…

Will one turn suffice?

I was thinking more like, I dunno, twelve, fifteen, something in there…  Remember, fighters are linear, wizards are quadratic.  With the team fully set up, we're more likely to win in about three turns (the minimum time for Wakey-Dreamy to get out ten Projections, unless she hits Violent Nightmares) than we would be in a longer time of not being set up, taking tons of damage from Dreamy every time and possibly being overwhelmed by another wave like what hit us in Ep. 19.
